name: Operations Management - I
description: The OM-1 curriculum focuses on the strategic design and operational control of value-creation processes. It begins with Operations Strategy, establishing how productivity and core competencies drive global competitive advantage. The course then moves into Project Management, utilizing CPM/PERT models to navigate complex, resource-constrained timelines. A significant portion is dedicated to Process Analysis and Design, covering capacity management, bottleneck analysis, and break-even calculations. It then addresses Statistical Process Control (SPC) to ensure high-quality standards through control charts. Finally, the course provides the logic for Operations Scheduling and Maintenance in shops and service systems.
